findings.title: Inherited lease cleanup can unlock parent flock without creator-PID ownership check
findings.sourceFact: Both normal and exceptional post-yield cleanup call flock(fd,LOCK_UN) unconditionally when locked. Handle validation checks process/thread on use, but cleanup does not check creator PID before LOCK_UN. Fork shares open-file description, so child normal context-manager/generator unwinding can release parent held exclusion.
